items.title: The Tesla Roadster Will ‘Blow People’s Minds’
items.summary: The new  Tesla  Roadster will be so cool that people might not believe early videos are not AI-generated, according to CEO Elon Musk.  Monday, Musk appeared on the All-In Podcast with  SpaceX  President Gwynne Shotwell.  The conversation was wide-ranging, touching on many topics including Starlink, Starship, AI, SpaceX and Tesla’s Terafab chip-making facility, and collaborations between the two companies.
